name: Qemu-static
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/qemu-static for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/qemu-static for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/qemu-static:10.0.13@sha256:85959e8657d2e2ec534febf9c34fb09198557191828d7c68361094803ce23e37
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
